messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live clock information right now, so I can’t give an exact “current” time.  
If it helps, New York City operates on U.S. Eastern Time (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 when Daylight Saving Time is observed), which changes at the usual March/November dates each year.  

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
message.reasoning:
The user asks "current time" but we have no tool for time; only weather. We cannot provide accurate answer. According to policy, if uncertain or can't compute, respond with uncertainty and ask clarifying question. So I should say I'm unsure about exact current time due to lack of real-time data. Ask them what timezone they refer to maybe? But it's NYC so Eastern Time. Could also mention daylight savings. I'll express uncertainty.

We can offer approximate based on UTC offset -5 or -4 depending DST. But better to state uncertainty.
